# Cinema Font Build Sources

These files are the pinned upstream inputs for the deterministic Mercury Cinema webfont subsets. They are versioned so a clean recovery clone can rebuild the approved outputs without relying on a developer cache or network availability.

Source URLs, upstream revisions, and SHA256 values are defined in `../../scripts/cinema-font-sources.json`. Redistribution notices are preserved in `../../app/assets/fonts/cinema/` and summarized in `../../app/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

Do not replace or modify a source file without a typography review, an updated manifest hash, rebuilt subset hashes, and the corresponding license review.
